authority.source: UrAi Generic World Library governed modular specification; generic exploration candidate

prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Level central path and accessible resting area; shallow non-navigable planting borders protect marker placement. No open graves or unexpected imagery. Target bounding dimensions 26m wide x 0.3m high x 24m deep. Materials: stone-muted. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
